reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS n_new_prices
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.parent_category = 'TV & Video' AND ph.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name
ORDER BY n_new_prices DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 10
alternatives: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS n_new_prices FROM price_history ph, products p, categories c WHERE ph.product_id = p.product_id AND p.category_id = c.category_id AND c.parent_category = 'TV & Video' AND year(ph.valid_from) = 2025 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name ORDER BY n_new_prices DESC, p.product_id LIMIT 10

SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name, COUNT(ph.valid_from) AS n_new_prices FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_from >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND ph.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-31' WHERE c.parent_category = 'TV & Video' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1 LIMIT 10

solver.query:
SELECT pr.product_id, pr.product_name, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS n_new_prices
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = pr.category_id
WHERE c.parent_category = 'TV & Video'
  AND ph.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY pr.product_id, pr.product_name, c.category_name
ORDER BY n_new_prices DESC, pr.product_id ASC
LIMIT 10
